name: open-code-review
description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
one_liner: An automated reviewer that reads every pull request, flags real security bugs (like SQL injection and XSS) and leaves precise comments, the way a senior engineer would.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size company who wants a consistent security and quality bar on every pull request without hiring more senior reviewers.
business_use_cases: A software agency bakes it into every client repo's CI to guarantee a baseline security review regardless of which junior developer wrote the code.
A fintech startup gets automatic line-level security comments on every pull request before a human reviewer looks, cutting review time.
A code-audit consultancy runs it against a client's whole codebase as the fast first pass of a paid security audit.

money_ideas.idea: A managed, hosted version for teams who don't want to self-host, billed per repo or seat
A flat-fee 'AI security review' service that uses it as the engine

steal_this: Offer a $500 flat-fee 'AI security review' this weekend: run it against a client's repo and hand them the report.
